products.name: Krea AI
products.note: Real-time video generation; creative tool; content moderation; emerging platform

profile_text.body:
Krea is a San Francisco-based company that describes itself as offering what it calls "the world's most powerful creative AI suite," providing tools to generate, edit, and enhance images and videos. Its platform brings together a range of third-party frontier models alongside its own capabilities, integrating offerings from ByteDance, Google, Alibaba, Minimax, and others into a single interface for creative work.

The company's primary product, Krea AI, is categorized as a video generation and editing platform with real-time video generation, content moderation, and image tools. The platform hosts models including ByteDance's Seedance lineup, Google's Veo and Gemini-based video and image models, Alibaba's latest generation video model, and Minimax's 2K rendering model, among others. Image generation models available through the platform include FLUX 3, a Qwen-based model, and a model the site calls Muse, which the company describes as searching the web for references and running code to handle elements such as charts and QR codes.

The held facts note no litigation, MCP registry presence, or SEC or patent filings associated with Krea at this time.
